consequence.statement: The remoteNodeIdentity Helm value is no longer honoured; remote nodes will always use remote-node identity. Network policies based on enable-remote-node-identity=false must be updated.
consequence.remediation: Remove remoteNodeIdentity from Helm values. Review and update any network policies that were based on enable-remote-node-identity=false to align with the new always-enabled remote-node identity behavior.

original.statement: The deprecated Helm value remoteNodeIdentity has been removed in Cilium 1.16.0; environments with this value explicitly set must update their configuration and any related network policies.

decision.reason: [ev-40ebe1cf329c] says the Helm option `remoteNodeIdentity` has been removed and that remote nodes will now always use the `remote-node` identity. So a configured value, in particular `false`, is no longer honoured, which fits setting-ignored. The same text tells operators to update network policies based on `enable-remote-node-identity=false`, which matches the proposed statement and remediation. For users on the default `true` there is no behaviour impact, but their key is still ignored, so medium severity is reasonable.
